Here `surface` is the check code; `evaluated_tickets` counts distinct observed tickets for that code, `catches` counts non-bypassed `verdict: fail` observations, `bypass_count` counts observations whose `bypassed` flag is true, and `catch_rate` is catches divided by all observations for that code (zero when absent). Phase 5 has no bug-report producer, so `escapes` and `escape_rate` are exactly zero until the Phase 6 escape-column ticket extends them. `prune_candidate` is true only when `evaluated_tickets >= 25` and both catches and escapes are zero. Focused tests cover invoice folding, malformed-input exclusion, distinct-ticket counting, bypass-versus-catch semantics, zero-denominator rates, the 25-ticket prune threshold, row ordering, report rendering, and prove projection leaves its input unchanged.
